name: 左文右圖＋斜線切分的雙圖
desc: 左欄純色底放大標題與說明，右欄約七成寬的圖片區被一條斜線切成上下兩格，各放一張圖片。
prompt: 主視覺上下不留白。版面分左右兩欄：左欄約佔主視覺寬的三成，為純色背景；右欄約佔七成，放圖片，貼齊主視覺的上緣、右緣與下緣。右欄由一條斜線切成上下兩格，斜線從右欄左緣約三分之一高處往右下延伸到右緣約三分之二高處，上下兩格各放一張圖片，下格面積較大；圖片可以是靜態圖片或持續播放的動態畫面。左欄放大標題（可多行），下方可放說明文字，沒有內容時省略，標題位置不變；兩者靠左對齊，在左欄內垂直置中、略偏上，上下留大片空白。左欄底部可放一個文字連結（短文字加一個小圖示），在左欄內水平置中，沒有內容時省略，其他元素的位置不變。
mobile: 左右兩欄改為上下排列，順序和桌機的左右相反：圖片區排在最上面，貼齊主視覺上緣，左右只留少許邊（比文字的內距窄），改為接近方形、略偏直式，佔主視覺約一半多的高度，斜線切成上下兩格的做法保留；大標題、說明文字與文字連結依序放在圖片下方，全部靠左對齊，文字連結不再置中。高度改為依內容而定。沒有捲動效果，動態畫面照常播放。

en.name: Split text left, diagonal image pair right
en.desc: A solid-color left column holds the headline and description; the right column, about seventy percent wide, is cut by a diagonal line into an upper and a lower cell, each holding an image.
en.prompt: The hero has no spacing at the top or bottom. The layout is split into two columns: the left column takes about thirty percent of the hero width and has a solid background; the right column takes about seventy percent and holds images, flush with the top, right and bottom edges of the hero. The right column is cut by a diagonal line into an upper and a lower cell; the line runs from about one third of the height on the left edge of the right column down to about two thirds of the height on its right edge. Each cell holds an image, and the lower cell is larger; the images may be still images or continuously playing motion footage. The left column holds a headline (may wrap to multiple lines); optionally place a description below it; omit it when there is no content, without changing the position of the headline. Both are left-aligned and vertically centered within the left column, slightly above center, with generous empty space above and below. Optionally place a text link (short text with a small icon) at the bottom of the left column, horizontally centered within the column; omit it when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements.
en.mobile: The two columns stack vertically, in the reverse of the desktop left-right order: the image area comes first at the very top, flush with the top edge of the hero, with only a small margin on the left and right (narrower than the text inner padding); it becomes roughly square, slightly portrait, taking a little over half the height of the hero, and keeps the diagonal split into upper and lower cells; the headline, description and text link follow below the image in that order, all left-aligned, and the text link is no longer centered. The height becomes content-based. There is no scroll effect; the motion footage keeps playing.

accessories.prompt: 在主視覺右下角、疊在圖片上放一張小型橫幅卡片：左側一張小圖，右側短文字，整張可點擊。
accessories.mobile: 小型橫幅卡片在手機版改為橫跨圖片區底部整列，疊在圖片下緣。

en.prompt: In the bottom-right corner of the hero, overlaid on the image, place a small banner card: a small image on the left and short text on the right, the whole card clickable.
en.mobile: On mobile the small banner card spans the full width of the bottom of the image area, overlaid on the image's bottom edge.
